_about: Public-domain Isaac Maddox (1697-1759), Bishop of St Asaph and then of Worcester, for the Word Hoard: his charge to the clergy of Worcester, and his sermons of 1734 to 1753, many of them for the London and Worcester infirmaries and charities. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 138 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. His anonymous Vindication of the Church of England (against Neal) is held until Adam rules on catalogue attributions.
